description: This script automates the generation and postprocessing of markdown documentation files from API header files and JSON files, including functions for converting headers to markdown, generating markdown from JSON, and updating documentation sidebar.

methods.name: generate_md
methods.description: Main function to generate markdown files from headers or JSON files for each plugin.

methods.name: convert_json_to_md
methods.description: Converts JSON plugin files into markdown documentation.

methods.name: convert_h_to_md
methods.description: Converts header files into markdown documentation.

methods.name: postprocess_md
methods.description: Postprocesses generated markdown files to clean up links and formatting.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that parses arguments and orchestrates the documentation generation process.
